scope: Independent float64 screening reimplementation of the 8D relative dynamics and variational monodromy; not publication truth and not a substitute for Julia BigFloat/canonical verification.

method.description: Starting from the six retained junction localizations in the frozen global event-network artifact, independently reimplemented the COM-relative 8D Newtonian equations and analytic variational Jacobian, eliminated the four fixed-mass shooting variables with the monodromy shooting Jacobian, and applied a two-dimensional Newton solve in (m1,m2) to G+=0 and G-=0.
method.screening_integrator: SciPy DOP853 float64, final evaluations at rtol=2e-11, atol=2e-13
method.acceptance_interpretation: The values below establish high-quality screening seeds for the independent BigFloat verifier. They do not by themselves establish a release-claim organizer.

conclusion: All three coarse +1/-1 mechanism switches now have high-quality mixed spectral-vertex screening candidates. Independent Julia BigFloat reproduction and canonical physical/Jordan/nondegeneracy classification are still mandatory before promotion.
